items.title: Chime Financial (CHYM) Will Join The S&P MidCap 400
items.summary: Chime Financial (NasdaqGS:CHYM) is set to join the S&P MidCap 400 following the completion of NorthWestern Energy’s acquisition. The index change will recognize Chime Financial as a mid-cap constituent, aligning it with a broader pool of institutional investors. Chime Financial expanded its Workday partnership to deepen integration into payroll and financial wellness tools used by large U.S. employers. items.title: Workday (WDAY) Deepens Its AI Push Through Two New Partnerships
items.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS:WDAY) has partnered with The Josh Bersin Company to integrate its Galileo AI-based HR advisory agent into Workday tools. The firm also announced a collaboration with Zuora to connect Workday finance applications with Zuora's AI and usage-based pricing capabilities. Both partnerships aim to expand Workday's AI-driven workforce planning and billing features for large enterprises.
